title: The lane closed on paper
body: The map is clipped to the lane board. Closed is written across the route, while the lunchbox still holds a warm-looking paper napkin and a pass marked out. No one has initialled the exit column.
rival_reading: A farm delivery could have used a temporary lane and left a pass in a vehicle after routine closure; an uninitialled column is not proof of a failed cordon.
gloss: A closed route and an outward pass remain together with no recorded exit.

title: Field wash, passenger line blank
body: The bucket has a chalked water level and the lunchbox contains a folded field meal. The same sheet records a lane hold, then asks for vehicle wash water while leaving the passenger line blank. A small flower is drawn beside it.
rival_reading: Officials could inspect a vehicle during an emergency restriction and leave passenger details for later; field water and a blank line do not establish a program malfunction.
gloss: A measured field wash is recorded beside a lane hold while the vehicle’s passenger line remains blank.
